summary: Shelby County, AL steel tower begun by the CCC in the late 1930s and finished by the Alabama Forestry Commission in 1942; NHLR-registered 2009 as US 843. Current condition not confirmed.

facts.design: 100' International Derrick & Equipment Company steel tower with 7'x7' cab
facts.status_note: The Register does not say whether the tower still stands or what condition it is in; the 'standing' status in our record is not confirmed by any source read

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page and a general 1819 News profile were read. The CCC-to-forestry handoff is taken from the NHLR description plus the profile's general account, not from a source about this tower. A search surfaced a different 'Pinnacle Lookout Tower' (a 1937 CCC tower over the Cumberland River, restored 2008) that is not this Shelby County tower and was not used. Forest Lookouts had no matching page under the guessed slugs. Status, staffing and access are unconfirmed.
